investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-07T07:28–07:36Z because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected by the Kubernetes scheduler: 2 of 6 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No preemption victims were available, so the pods remained unscheduled for 132–145 seconds before the eval timed out, producing zero evidence and failing all required contract assertions.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource slots on the 2 nodes that carry that resource. The other 4 nodes are ineligible due to node affinity or selector constraints on the remote-agent pod spec. Because no pod could be scheduled, the createAgent call in run-status-probes.mjs never completed, no agent or VM was provisioned, and the eval returned empty evidence — violating all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) defined in check-expectations.json. This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity constraint, not a confirmed user-traffic outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigation.title: Remote Agent Pods Unschedulable Due to Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity — All Three Remote-Agent Checks Failing
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-07T07:31–07:36Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the eval's remote-agent pod because only 2 nodes carry the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource and both reported that resource as exhausted, while the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Because the pod never became schedulable, the eval runner's createAgent call in run-status-probes.mjs never returned an agent, and no evidence (orgId, agentId, readyState, state) was written, causing the remote-agent-state contract to fail with all four required fields missing.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the production-api remote-agent swarm has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity across the 2 eligible nodes. The eval runner (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1905) calls createAgent with type "remote", which submits a pod requiring the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource. With 0 of 6 nodes available and preemption unable to free capacity, the pod remained Unschedulable for 145 s before the eval timed out. No agent was ever created, so the state-polling step that would produce orgId, agentId, readyState, and state evidence was never reached. This is an infrastructure capacity failure localized to the kata peer-pods VM pool, not a code defect in the eval runner or contract definitions. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence; impact is currently confirmed only at the eval layer.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigations.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-07T07:28–07:36Z because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected by the Kubernetes scheduler: 2 of 6 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No preemption victims were available, so the pods remained unscheduled for 132–145 seconds before the eval timed out, producing zero evidence and failing all required contract assertions.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource slots on the 2 nodes that carry that resource. The other 4 nodes are ineligible due to node affinity or selector constraints on the remote-agent pod spec. Because no pod could be scheduled, the createAgent call in run-status-probes.mjs never completed, no agent or VM was provisioned, and the eval returned empty evidence — violating all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) defined in check-expectations.json. This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity constraint, not a confirmed user-traffic outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
